name: wardley-maps-modeler
description: Wardley Mapping for Claude: the method after Simon Wardley (value chains, evolution stages, doctrine, climatic patterns and gameplay, creating maps from a strategic question, map reviews with colour-coded feedback notes) and the complete OWM text DSL — grammar, coordinates and layout, parser diagnostics and the round-trip guarantee — so Claude can read, write, review and generate Wardley Maps as plain `.wmap` / `.owm` text.
